wargear.name: Warp-brand
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. The unit has been marked by one of the Powers, a sigil burned into the flesh that will not heal. All models in the unit gain +1 Attack.

wargear.name: Ruin-shard crown
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A fragment of the Ruinstorm worn as a diadem, bleeding unreality into the air. The bearer's unit gains Fear (1).

wargear.name: Bloodied skull-rack
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A frame of skulls taken from champions, still weeping from the ruin they came from.

wargear.name: Chime of stolen hours
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A bell whose note drags the surroundings a heartbeat out of step.

wargear.name: Canker-urn
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A bronze urn that vents a slow, sweet-smelling miasma.

wargear.name: Mirror-glass aegis
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A hall of mirrors ground into a shield, returning every threat as an unwelcome gift.

wargear.name: Lash-gall harness
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Barbed rigging cutting into the pack's flanks and driving them into a rage.

wargear.name: Hollow idol
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. An effigy of stolen faces that anchors lesser daemons to the world.

wargear.name: Ruin-barbs
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Quills of hardened unreality that jut out from the hide at every angle.

rules.name: Warp Rift Tide
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Gnashing Tide). A unit with this rule may be placed in Reserves and arrive by Deep Strike. If it is still in Reserve at the start of its controller's second turn, it arrives automatically without a Reserves roll.

rules.name: Threads of Fate
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Pale Banner of Fate). After both sides have deployed and before the first battle turn, up to three friendly units with this rule may each make a free move of up to 6". None may end that move within 12" of an enemy model.

rules.name: Skulls for the Throne
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Red Tide of Ka'bandha). A unit with this rule adds 1 to its Charge roll. On a turn it charges, it must charge the closest enemy unit it can reach.

rules.name: Creeping Rot
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Rot Unbidden). Enemy models in base contact with a model with this rule subtract 1 from their Initiative.

rules.name: Irresistible Allure
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Rapture's Invitation). An enemy unit charged by a unit with this rule subtracts 1 from its Initiative until the end of that Assault phase.

rules.name: Skull Tally
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Each time the bearer's unit destroys an enemy Character in combat, the bearer gains +1 Attack until the end of the battle (maximum +2).

rules.name: Slipped Moment
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Once per battle, at the end of its controlling player's turn, the bearer's unit may be removed from the battlefield and placed in Reserve to arrive next turn by Deep Strike.

rules.name: Festering Cloud
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Enemy models within 3" of the bearer subtract 1 from their Toughness.

rules.name: Hall of Mirrors
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Enemy Psychic Checks made to target the bearer suffer -1. The first time each battle the bearer suffers an unsaved wound from a Shooting Attack, the shooter's unit suffers one automatic Hit (S3, AP -).

rules.name: Goaded Pack
rules.text: Legacy house rule. A Charge roll of less than 6 made by the unit counts as 6.

rules.name: Anchoring Idol
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Once per battle, the unit may treat a failed Morale or Cool Check as passed.

rules.name: Barbed Ruin
rules.text: Legacy house rule. An enemy unit that Charges the bearer's unit suffers one automatic Hit (S4, AP -) for each model in base contact.

armyRules.name: Tethered to the Storm
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. Ruinstorm daemons are held in the material world by the storm's fury and slip away when it quiets. A Malefic unit gains a 5+ Invulnerable Save if it was worse. At the end of its controlling player's turn, a unit that neither made nor suffered an attack that turn must pass a Cool Check or lose one model.

armyRules.name: Anchor of the Storm
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. Greater powers bind the lesser to their will. A friendly Malefic unit within 12" of a Sovereign, Hierarch, Harbinger, Ascendant Lord or Herald adds 1 to its Cool. If that commander is slain, each such unit must make a Cool Check or gain the Stunned Status.

armyRules.name: Shifting Fates
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. The Changer's servants are never quite where the enemy aimed. Tzeentch units gain a 5+ Invulnerable Save if it was worse, but subtract 1 from their Cool as their attention wanders.

rites.name: The Gnashing Tide
rites.flavor: The Ruinstorm does not march. It rises, and it keeps rising.
benefits: Daemon Harriers and Riders may fill Troops slots; they, Lesser Daemons and Daemon Swarms gain Line (1).
Those units gain Warp Rift Tide: they may arrive by Deep Strike, and any still in Reserve at the start of turn two arrive automatically.
limitations: At least one Lesser Daemons unit is required.
No Lord of War and no War Engine units.
At least half of the Lesser Daemons and Daemon Swarms units must start the battle in Reserve.

modifiers.text: The Gnashing Tide: Line (1), Deep Strike, Warp Rift Tide.

require.note: The tide needs its Lesser Daemons.

rites.name: The Pale Banner of Fate
rites.flavor: The future is a river, and a river can be made to run uphill if you ask it in the right voice.
benefits: Flamers and Screamers of Tzeench may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Tzeench units gain Threads of Fate: after deployment and before the first turn, up to three Tzeench units may each make a free move of up to 6".
limitations: A Lord of Change, Ascendant Lord or Herald of Tzeench is required.
Only Tzeench daemons and Heresy-born war machines: no Ruinstorm units and no Ka'bandha, Cor'bax or Samus.

modifiers.text: The Pale Banner of Fate: Line (1).
The Pale Banner of Fate: Threads of Fate.

rites.name: The Red Tide of Ka'bandha
rites.flavor: Skulls for the throne. All of them. All at once.
benefits: Ruinstorm Daemon Brutes and Blood Slaughterers may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
They gain Skulls for the Throne: Charge rolls gain +1.
limitations: Ka'bandha must be in the army.
No Psykers and no Tzeench units.
A unit with Skulls for the Throne must charge the closest enemy unit it can reach.

modifiers.text: The Red Tide: Line (1), Skulls for the Throne.

rites.name: Rot Unbidden
rites.flavor: It does not hurry. It has never needed to.
benefits: The Daemon Behemoth and Greater Daemon Beast may fill Elites slots.
Every Malefic model gains Feel No Pain (6+) and Creeping Rot: enemy models in base contact with it subtract 1 from their Initiative.
limitations: Cor'bax Utterblight must be in the army.
No Recon or Fast Attack units.

modifiers.text: Rot Unbidden: Feel No Pain (6+), Creeping Rot, -1 M.

rites.name: Rapture's Invitation
rites.flavor: They do not want to hurt you. They want you to ask them to.
benefits: Daemon Harriers and Riders gain Fast (1), Outflank and Irresistible Allure: an enemy unit they charge subtracts 1 from its Initiative until the end of that Assault phase.
limitations: Samus must be in the army.
No Heavy Assault or War Engine units, and no Decimators.

modifiers.text: Rapture's Invitation: Fast (1), Outflank, Irresistible Allure.
